svg.title: Notas & Anotações
svg.desc: Bloco de notas vinculado ao timestamp do vídeo. Permite criar, editar e excluir notas com carimbos de tempo clicáveis para navegar na aula. — Design System AUVP · tema escuro

g.class: bg-muted/50 border-b border-border px-5 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
svg-content lucide lucide-pen-line h-4 w-4 text-accent
text-xs font-bold text-accent hover:text-accent/80 transition-colors font-anek uppercase tracking-wider
rounded-lg p-4 group relative bg-primary/5 border border-primary/20
text-xs text-accent bg-accent/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono hover:bg-accent/20 transition-colors cursor-pointer
